shapeOriginAssessment.method: Inspect per-feature vertex counts, circularity, radial-distance variation, convexity, rotated-rectangle area fraction and edge-length distribution, plus map overview of exact service vertices.
shapeOriginAssessment.conclusion: These checks are fingerprints only. Irregular named polygons and thematic boundaries can share straight edges, and metadata does not establish the original boundary construction method. Do not infer official or hard-boundary status merely from valid source polygons.
shapeOriginAssessment.visualInspection: Reviewed exact-vertex full77feature overview and central source partition. Shapes are irregular named pieces with coarse shared edges, varied vertex counts and detached rural settlements. No regular circles or repeated square/rectangle templates are apparent. This does not independently exclude a tessellation-derived original source or establish road alignment.

identityDisposition.typeFieldCaveat: tipus describes source morphology/use, not authoritative quarter identity. In particular erdo must not automatically exclude Auguszta or Egyetemváros.

outcome.geometryAuthenticityFromRetrievedService: Native and serviceGeoJSON equivalence quantified perFID; source coordinates retained as received.

systematicPlacementDiagnostic.method: Compare metric centroids of the25exact-name matching source pieces, excluding ambiguousFID11. Source minus OSM baseline in EPSG23700; these centroids diagnose dataset disagreement and are not georeferencing controls.
systematicPlacementDiagnostic.interpretation: A shared westward and generally southward displacement is visible relative to this unreviewedOSMbaseline. Neither cause nor which source is more accurate is established. Direct service authenticity and correct declared CRS transformation do not establish real-world placement accuracy. No translation, datum reinterpretation or correction was fitted or applied.
